# IMQORMOptions.logger property

Where SQL statements are logged.

**Signature:**

```typescript
logger: ILogger;
```

## Remarks

Falls back to the `@imqueue/rpc` service default, then to `console`<!-- -->, so it can be left out. `@imqueue/async-logger` is the usual choice.
